analysis_boundary: Grid associations are descriptive model associations, not causal human effects or a continuous optimal-control solution; conditioning on the valid-impact selection rule can bias the associations.
interface_force_boundary: peak_grip_force_n is the net modeled planar wrist-interface force on the club, not either hand's anatomical grip force.
falsification_tests: A speed association that vanishes after timing and drive controls weakens the high-velocity interpretation.
A candidate dominated on speed, braking work, and peak force is not an optimal strategy.
A rotating-base two-hand model that reverses the result rejects transfer to torso strategy.
